source_state_rule: Root plus first nonterminal nonroot expanded state; if unavailable, first accepted nonterminal successor. No success-conditioned source selection.
selection: Equal-family validation Brier score for completion, successful conditional log-attempt MSE for cost; ties favor linear. Conservative margin maximizes matched validation completion, ties favor larger margin. No refit on validation.
labels: 1 means independent verification within the stated budget; 0 is observed bounded noncompletion, never mathematical falsity. Errors, unavailable and unrun observations are missing, never zeros.
automation: Separate opaque Aesop/grind reference, 2 seconds per call under the same outer 18-second cap; attempts are not primitive work.
inference: Current native goals/context and remaining budgets only. No IDs, prefixes, future outcomes or answer scripts.
uncertainty: 10000 paired theorem bootstrap samples seed707; separate equal-family cluster sensitivity; all regressions retained; no final-result retuning.
boundary: Historical evaluation is diagnosis only; old permitted development statements may be recollected. New evaluation families differ from development schemata, but share elementary proof primitives; not externally blinded.
